To stay within your limit, the app will work in passes of at most %1$.0f s and use %2$d thread(s). It takes longer, but will not stop because of memory.

Your limit is lower than the model weights alone. The app will still run: shortest passes, at most 2 threads, and if Android stops the engine for lack of memory, the app waits for free memory and continues from the last finished pass. Expect it to be much slower; a smaller quantization (e.g. Q4_K_M) is recommended.

Generating music uses the processor at full load for a long time (minutes to hours). The phone may get hot and the battery will drain quickly - keep it charging, out of direct sun and without a case. Overheating protection: %1$s.

By default audio goes to Music/ACE_music_gen and MIDI, notation and metadata to Download/ACE_music_gen, in a folder per track (no permission needed). You can pick your own folder for every kind of file - the app then saves into <folder>/<track>/. If a picked folder becomes unavailable, the default is used and the log says so.
No access to this folder any more - the default location will be used. Pick it again.
Results: audio → Music/ACE_music_gen, MIDI and notation → Download/ACE_music_gen. Change in Settings → Save locations.

No access to the picked folder for: %1$s - saved in the default location instead.
